msg: Personally, I didn't find that picking by colors was all that helpful. It was a bit hard to keep track of, too. What I did was pick a side - either the s side or the k side, and stick to it for a while. If it started to consistently give lower values, I would switch sides. Also, make sure to check if the points get the 5x bonus or not, because the number might look low, but if it's only a 1x bonus, it's still getting you good points. (3-4 or more is good, 7-8 is awesome for the 1x bonus).
